style: Rustic medieval European village furniture, hand-made from weathered dark oak and pine with dark iron fittings, worn edges and realistic materials. A single free-standing object with nothing around it.

bed.prompt: A simple medieval wooden bed: a low frame of rough-hewn oak planks with four short posts and a plank headboard, a straw-filled linen mattress, a folded grey wool blanket and a flat pillow.

bunk.prompt: A medieval two-tier wooden bunk bed of rough-hewn pine posts and planks, a straw-filled linen mattress and a rumpled brown wool blanket on each tier, a short ladder at one end.

table.prompt: A sturdy medieval trestle table: a top of three thick rough oak planks resting on two A-shaped trestle legs joined by a stretcher, worn and stained.

stool.prompt: A small three-legged wooden stool with a thick round seat, hand-carved and worn smooth.

chair.prompt: A simple medieval wooden chair with four straight legs, a woven rush seat and a straight back of two slats.

chest.prompt: A medieval oak storage chest with a flat lid, three iron bands, iron corner plates and a hasp lock, weathered.

shelf.prompt: A free-standing rustic open wooden shelf with three boards holding clay jugs, stacked bowls, wooden cups, a small sack and a coil of rope.

cupboard.prompt: A tall rustic wooden cupboard of vertical planks with two closed doors, iron strap hinges and a wooden latch.

desk.prompt: A small medieval writing desk with a slanted top, an open leather-bound ledger, a clay inkwell with a quill and a candle stub.

bookshelf.prompt: A tall wooden archive shelf packed with leather-bound books, rolled scrolls tied with cord and stacked ledgers.

hearth.prompt: A rustic fireplace built against a wall: a tall rectangular surround of rough fieldstones with a wide dark arched firebox, a thick soot-stained wooden mantel beam across the top, a raised stone hearth slab in front, an iron pot hanging over a few logs inside.
hearth.retired: Two takes gave loose pots and logs instead of a fireplace; rooms build their fireplace in code at the chimney stack.

oven.prompt: A domed bread oven of weathered grey-brown clay, soot-blackened around its dark arched mouth, on a low base of fieldstones, with a long wooden bread peel leaning against it.

counter.prompt: A long medieval shop counter of thick wooden planks with a closed plank front, a set of iron scales and a few coins on top.

workbench.prompt: A carpenter's heavy wooden workbench with a wooden vice, a mallet, chisels, a hand saw and curled wood shavings on top.

rack.prompt: A wooden weapon rack holding two swords upright, a spear and a round wooden shield with an iron boss.

altar.prompt: A small stone altar with a carved front panel, a linen cloth on top, a bronze offering bowl and several half-burnt candles.

sacks.prompt: A pile of four tied burlap grain sacks slumped against each other.

loom.prompt: A medieval upright warp-weighted loom with a half-woven striped wool cloth and a row of clay loom weights hanging along the bottom.
